paragraphs.text:
By wading along a shallow stream, the creature nearly shakes 
you off its trail, but you are too experienced to be foiled by 
such a trick. The pursuit takes you and Norman up into the 
high ground.
The prints become fresher as you climb.
Make a Stealth roll: if you succeed, go to 290; if you fail, go to 289.
